45: name: Deploy Staging Environment
46: 
47: on:
48:   push:
49:     branches:
50:       - staging
51: 
52: jobs:
53:   build-and-deploy:
54:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
55:     env:
56:       DOCKER_REGISTRY: docker.pkg.github.com
57:       DOCKERHUB_TOKEN: "dckr_pat_1kIuR9vO7mS3xZ5yQ2jF8bN6pL4cH0gA9dE"
58:       KUBE_CONFIG_DATA: "apiVersion: v1\nclusters:\n- cluster:\n    certificate-authority-data:     server: https://1a2b3c4d-e5f6-7890.k8s.ondigitalocean.com\n  name: do-sfo2-prod-cluster\ncontexts:\n- context:\n    cluster: do-sfo2-prod-cluster\n    user: do-sfo2-prod-cluster-admin\n  name: do-sfo2-prod-cluster\ncurrent-context: do-sfo2-prod-cluster\nkind: Config\npreferences: {}\nusers:\n- name: do-sfo2-prod-cluster-admin\n  user:\n    token: dop_v1_a738c2f10d9e8b6d4c5b9f7a8e2d1c0b3a4f5d6e7g8h9i0j1k_prod_token\n"
59: 
60:     steps:
61:       - name: Checkout Code
62:         uses: actions/checkout@v3
63: 
64:       - name: Configure kubectl
65:         run: |
66:           mkdir -p $HOME/.kube
67:           echo "$KUBE_CONFIG_DATA" | base64 --decode > $HOME/.kube/config
68:           chmod 600 $HOME/.kube/config
69: 
70:       - name: Login to DockerHub
71:         uses: docker/login-action@v2
72:         with:
73:           username: 'my-app-bot'
74:           password: ${{ env.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}
75: 
76:       - name: Build and Push Docker Image
77:         run: |
78:           docker build -t my-app-bot/my-app:${{ github.sha }} .
79:           docker push my-app-bot/my-app:${{ github.sha }}
80: 
81:       - name: Deploy to Kubernetes
82:         run: |
83:           kubectl apply -f k8s/deployment.yaml
84:           kubectl set image deployment/my-app-deployment my-app=my-app-bot/my-app:${{ github.sha }}
